channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The grid rules moved more than prices over the long weekend. On 9 Oct FERC accepted PJM's 50 MW Large Load definition and registry, effective today, but rejected the interim service that would have let PJM curtail new data centers early in emergencies, so new AI load in the largest US market avoids forced early curtailment for now while PJM still runs about 6.8 GW short. In Finland, Sesterce plans a EUR 10bn-plus AI campus at the former Kaipola paper mill in Jamsa (200 MW first phase, 600 MW second) and says a contract with one of the two leading AI labs is signed. Indiana regulators approved AES Indiana's plan to serve Google's 390 MW Monrovia data center, the first under the state's large-load law. On the tape, DigitalOcean B300 spot fell to $6.17 from $8.00, now below its $7.94 12-month reserved rate; everything else confirmed: 68 confirms, 1 tick, 0 NEW.

item.title: Compute brief - 12 October 2026
item.description: The grid rules moved more than prices over the long weekend. On 9 Oct FERC accepted PJM's 50 MW Large Load definition and registry, effective today, but rejected the interim service that would have let PJM curtail new data centers early in emergencies, so new AI load in the largest US market avoids forced early curtailment for now while PJM still runs about 6.8 GW short. In Finland, Sesterce plans a EUR 10bn-plus AI campus at the former Kaipola paper mill in Jamsa (200 MW first phase, 600 MW second) and says a contract with one of the two leading AI labs is signed. Indiana regulators approved AES Indiana's plan to serve Google's 390 MW Monrovia data center, the first under the state's large-load law. On the tape, DigitalOcean B300 spot fell to $6.17 from $8.00, now below its $7.94 12-month reserved rate; everything else confirmed: 68 confirms, 1 tick, 0 NEW. Countries: United States / PJM: FERC ER26-3515 (9 Oct): 50 MW Large Load definition and registry effective 12 Oct; IRAS curtailment, BYONC and demand-curve exclusion rejected; PJM compliance filing due in 30 days (Wire). Finland: Sesterce Kaipola, Jamsa: EUR 10bn-plus plan, 200 MW phase 1 (works from 2026), 600 MW phase 2; anchor client signed (unnamed top AI lab); site purchase and permits pending (Wire, 8 Oct). United States / Indiana: IURC approves AES Indiana large-load plan for Google's 390 MW Monrovia site; 80% minimum demand; 15-year-plus contract; first under HEA 1007 (Wire, 7 Oct). Norway: VivoPower mobilizes construction of a 40 MW first-phase AI conversion at Mo i Rana; preferred tenant selected, lease not signed (Signal, 12 Oct). Malaysia: Budget 2027 (9 Oct): Sovereign AI Cloud 'now being planned', no size, site, cost or builder (Signal).
